# Crawling

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Movement](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Crawling)*

While you're crawling, each foot of movement costs 1 extra foot (2 extra feet in [Difficult Terrain](Difficult-Terrain.md)). *See also* "[Speed](Speed.md)."
